relationships.subject: choline
relationships.evidence_quote: Choline significantly attenuated mechanical and heat hypersensitivity in CCI rats at 12 and 24 mg/kg doses

relationships.subject: parecoxib sodium
relationships.evidence_quote: Parecoxib sodium is a highly selective cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) inhibitor.

relationships.subject: choline
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with levels in the saline-treated CCI rats, the levels of HMGB1 and NF-κBp65 were significantly decreased in CCI rats that received combined choline (6 mg/kg) and parecoxib (3 mg/kg) treatment for 7 days (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: HMGB1 can bind and activate Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) receptors and induce the production and release of inflammatory factors.

key_findings: Low-dose choline plus parecoxib relieved CCI pain and reduced DRG HMGB1 and NF-κBp65, whereas single low doses did not.
